notes: Help model m3l, the full-table lme (Schabenberger and Pierce 2002, p.518, proc mixed output 7.27): group-specific (age x species) quadratic trends in time with a random intercept and ti-slope per tree, plus a corExp(day|tree) residual correlation lme4 cannot express. ti=day/100 and ti2=ti^2 are built in the example from the day column. 40 trees (10 per species x age cell), repeated measures about every 5 days; the earlier models m1n/m1l/m2l fit the A2,S2 subgroup only and are not used (the survey uses the full table). Linear in parameters (polynomial in time), not nonlinear.
